opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based institutions; applicants must have a formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution for the project duration. Not open to individuals without such a relationship, schools, further education colleges, undergraduates, master’s students, PhD‑fee projects, establishment of academic posts, ongoing costs, local charities, or organisations not based in the UK (except exceptional overseas cases).
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £500,000 (or up to £750,000 in special cases) for research addressing any of the Foundation’s five priority questions. Two application rounds per year (Spring and Autumn) with an outline deadline of 5 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applications from individuals and organisations, particularly from racially minoritised communities, based in the UK. Partnership applications that involve racially minoritised communities are strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, with a 2026 priority theme on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges in a racially diverse UK. Grants range from £15k to £500k and the next deadline is 5 October 2026.
